060c5b9a38f366c1511a4f1db967cf18980fbf4c.summary: News article published 2025-02-24 on EU sanctions against Russia-linked individuals and media. Per the European Council, sanctioned North Korean intelligence chief Lee Chang Ho oversaw cyberattack units, including those known as Lazarus and Kimsuky, and coordinated North Korean soldiers in Ukraine. The article says researchers believe the RGB intelligence agency is responsible for most North Korean cyber operations, and that Kimsuky, Lazarus and Andariel were previously attributed to it.
